@web-ts-toolkit/oidc-vault-dpop-client — browser vault sessions and scoped API fetch.
Start with README.md: Quickstart, Explicit Bearer, Backend pairing, Recovery, Upgrade notes.
Omitted/true dpop = unchanged default DPoP; explicit false = immutable Bearer.
No automatic fallback/negotiation. Fresh login to switch, never rebind by refresh.
Both modes use app-local tokens, NOT IdP access/ID/refresh tokens. Bearer theft permits replay.
Session maintenance: README "Observing credentials" and "Opt-in proactive refresh".

Install: pnpm add @web-ts-toolkit/oidc-vault-dpop-client
jose + idb are dependencies. No Express/backend runtime or ambient types needed.
Node tooling/import/require: >=22.12.0 (CJS uses default require(esm) for jose).
DPoP needs secure-context Web Crypto, IndexedDB CryptoKey persistence + sessionStorage.
Body Bearer needs secure-context digest/UUID + sessionStorage, NOT IndexedDB/CryptoKey.
Cookie Bearer needs IndexedDB metadata + Web Locks + BroadcastChannel (as does cookie DPoP).
Named root imports only, no default export/subpaths or src/dist deep imports:
  import { createOidcVaultDpopSession, fetchWithDpop } from
    '@web-ts-toolkit/oidc-vault-dpop-client';
Other runtime exports: getOrCreateDpopKey, createDpopProof, DpopNonceCache,
createDeviceFingerprint, fingerprintJsSignalSource, OidcVaultDpopClientError.
Full root type list and member contracts: README API reference + index.d.mts.
Both declaration conditions are DOM-only (types:[], skipLibCheck:false).
Wire DTOs come from express-oidc-vault/wire at build time and are bundled here.
Root DTOs: OidcVaultLogoutNavigationInput, OidcVaultLogoutNavigationResult (DOM-only).

Session: createOidcVaultDpopSession({backendOrigin,basePath,sessionTransport})
defaults to /auth/oidc + body. login -> exchange(code) -> API/refresh -> logout.
Bootstrap removes/exchanges a callback code once or refreshes existing storage.
login/exchange include temporary cookies; refresh/logout body=omit+sessionId,
cookie=include+{} (no handle in JSON). JWTs: memory; handles/pending login:
tab-local sessionStorage; scoped keys/coordination metadata: IndexedDB.

Explicit Bearer: createOidcVaultDpopSession({...options,dpop:false}); same helper names,
no aliases/default export. Pair primarily with optional vault binding + local tokenIssuer.
Disabled binding WITH recognition can supply guarded POST login; disabled WITHOUT recognition
is unsupported (no legacy GET fallback). Required vault binding rejects Bearer. APIs must
independently authenticate/authorize unbound tokens; required API binding still rejects them.
Bearer interface omits getKey/resetKey/logoutAndNavigate; runtime probes reject fixed
nonterminal DPOP_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED before side effects. Ordinary logout works after expiry.
New root types: BearerAccessToken, OidcVaultAccessToken, OidcVaultBearerSessionOptions,
OidcVaultSessionOptions, OidcVaultBearerSession, OidcVaultSession, BearerApi,
BearerFetchContext, OidcVaultFetchContext. Existing DPoP types remain exact/required-jkt.
Runtime-boolean options return session.dpop union; observer narrows tokenType before jkt.

onCredentialsChanged(mode credential|undefined): asynchronous/coalesced latest
committed state, independent of scheduling; includes API refresh/peer adoption/clear.
Never await observers or persist tokens; callback failures cannot veto rotation.
autoRefresh: omitted/false by default; object enables after explicit exchange/refresh.
Root type OidcVaultDpopAutoRefreshOptions: refreshBeforeExpiryMs (enabled default60000,
lead not interval, 0..2147483647), optional maxRefreshIntervalMs (1000..2147483647).
Known lifetime caps lead to half; 1s minimum cadence, zero/nonlive result pauses.
Maximum interval is explicit keep-alive policy; either scheduler can extend idle,
neither tracks activity/extends absolute expiry/guarantees refresh during suspension.
Cookie refreshedAt is a generation-bound non-credential clock hint; peer receipt
does not reset it, missing/future hints make an enabled maximum deadline due.
onAutoRefreshError(unknown): failure pauses, no blanket retry; explicit local success
rearms, resume/online/unsolicited peers do not. Retain "Sign in again" recovery.
Failed manual refresh pauses silently too; no implicit timer retry of uncertain work.

Bound profile: exact DPoP, canonical compact signed JWT, exact cnf:{jkt}, safe
mandatory exp seconds/millisecond arithmetic. Decoding is NOT authentication;
APIs verify JWT/proof. Server unbound/opaque compatibility remains. expiresIn:0
retains rotation handles but no live API/peer token (DPOP_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED).
Bearer direct tokenType exact Bearer or omitted/undefined normalized; peers exact Bearer.
Header-safe visible-ASCII opaque tokens supported; exactly3 segments reserve canonical signed
JWT profile, malformed candidates reject, no b64:false/present cnf; optional safe exp clamps.
INVALID_BEARER_CREDENTIAL_RESPONSE terminal; invalid peers ignored. Zero lifetime retains
handles, nonlive use pauses/stops with nonterminal BEARER_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED, no loop.

Lifecycle/recovery: FIFO mutations; refresh coalesces until an intervening call.
Cookie mode adds same-origin/scope locks + 180ms peer wait. clear invalidates local
auth/owned HTTP but retains key; dispose closes context and retains reload state.
resetKey deletes only scoped key+metadata; await then login. Existing corrupt keys
need this explicit recovery; no automatic reset/Bearer fallback. logout requests
server revocation; reset leaves old sessions/JWTs until revocation/expiry.
DPOP_OPERATION_SUPERSEDED / DPOP_SESSION_DISPOSED are non-terminal; stale work
cannot publish/navigate/clear newer auth. See README's cleanup/recovery tables.
Cookie mode/generation union uses SAME historical lock/channel/database; no fake jkt,
key migration or Bearer key-store reads. Missing-mode legacy records/messages mean DPoP-only.
Reload needs active same-mode metadata. Same mode/generation/current recognition/expiry
plus final metadata recheck gate peer adoption; opposite modes never adopt/clear successor.
Unmodified old tabs cannot honor mode authority: close/reload/upgrade before switching,
then fresh login. Mixed old-version/mode tabs on one cookie authority are unsupported;
independent modes require distinct backend cookie authorities. JWTs not instantly revoked.

Provider logout (DPoP ONLY): server logoutNavigation opt-in + session.logoutAndNavigate():Promise<void>.
Existing key/handle or active matching cookie metadata; absent/expired JWT works,
no refresh/fingerprint/Authorization/ath. Same HTTP bounds/nonce cache, one fresh-proof retry.
Exact pinned backend bare or canonical ticket URL only; no API token in GET/IdP URL in JSON.
Confirmed loggedOut:true clears old state even on INVALID_LOGOUT_NAVIGATION_RESPONSE.
Unconfirmed/lost responses retain uncertainty, no navigation or automatic mutation retry.
Clicks share one Promise/adapter call; FIFO preserves rotation. Login/exchange/local logout/
clear/reset/dispose withdraw old navigation intent immediately, including queued login.
Synchronous navigate adapter handles login AND logout inside authority; do not defer handoff.
Single-use ticket (default60s, 1..120s) -> provider or fixed fallback; replay falls back.
Hint URL retained server-side until consume/expiry/cleanup; navigation URLs remain log/history
exposures. After IdP handoff its availability/return is not guaranteed. logout() stays local.

HTTP: requestTimeoutMs=15000 ms per vault headers/body/JSON attempt;
maxResponseBytes=1048576 streamed bytes. Bounds exclude queue/storage/key/hooks/
other locks. Timeout/size errors retain auth. API/proof signal stops only this
waiter, not shared refresh/already-started crypto. API bodies are caller-owned.
Abort is not server/Set-Cookie rollback; lost rotation can need login. No network retry.

API: fetchWithDpop({session,apis},url,options?). DpopApi.pathPrefix uses longest
normalized segment match; omission/root is origin-wide, duplicates reject.
Outbound paths normalize unreserved escapes/dots, preserve reserved separators
and query data. Separate gateway namespaces isolate nonces. Auth headers are
owned; redirect:error, no-store, API credentials:omit default. Fresh proof/JTI/ath.
Retry-enabled APIs: one use_dpop_nonce retry + one invalid_token refresh budget;
only unambiguous HTTP-401 DPoP challenges qualify. Mutations default single-attempt;
'idempotent' needs a server contract; 'never' forbids retries. Learn success/final
nonces even without retry: 64 tuples, oldest-remembered eviction, no inferred TTL.
Vaults retry nonce once, then DPOP_NONCE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED; final API Responses are caller-owned.
Bearer API: only Authorization:Bearer, no proof/key/nonce work. Namespace optional ONLY
definitely-Bearer contexts; supplied values validated but unused. Runtime mode needs namespaces.
Bearer permits at most2 API attempts and one shared refresh budget incl initial acquisition;
only valid active-scheme HTTP401 invalid_token if retry policy allows. No nonce retry.
Other-scheme/malformed/generic errors authorize no retries; unsafe defaults/'never' unchanged.

Errors: requiresLogin covers terminal session/key/browser/recognition failures,
and confirmed current OIDC_VAULT_REFRESH_REJECTED (not specifically expiry).
not every 401. Proof/nonce/transient errors retain auth; unknown server codes ->
fixed OIDC_REQUEST_FAILED. Optional recognition is change detection, never PoP.
Limits: same-origin locks are not distributed leases. Chromium/Firefox loopback
evidence does not certify Safari/WebKit/cross-site cookies; see README.
